fragment:
<set-variable name="gatewayCode" value='@(context.LastError.Reason == "BackendConnectionFailure" ||
        context.LastError.Reason == "PoolIsInactive" ? "UpstreamUnavailable" :
        context.LastError.Reason == "Timeout" && context.LastError.Section == "backend" ? "UpstreamTimeout" :
        context.LastError.PolicyId == "resolve-model-pool" && context.LastError.Section == "inbound" &&
        context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("routePhase", "") == "resolve" ? "model_not_available" : "GatewayError")' />
    
    
    
    
        routing-error
        
        <metadata name="scenario" value='@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("scenario", "unknown"))' />
        
        
        
    
    
        
        application/json
        @(context.RequestId.ToString())
        @{
            var code = (string)context.Variables["gatewayCode"];
            var message = code == "model_not_available" ? "The specified model is not available for use" :
                code == "UpstreamTimeout" ? "The upstream request timed out." :
                code == "UpstreamUnavailable" ? "The upstream service is unavailable." : "The gateway could not complete the request.";

            return new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("code", code), new JProperty("message", message)))).ToString();
        }
